svg.title: U.S. green-card grants by birthplace
svg.desc: Resident stocks and status grants have distinct periods and populations; not all physical arrivals.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Fiscal years 2000–2024 | includes arrivals and adjustments
DHS/OHSS, country of birth, not nationality. Includes people already in the U.S. adjusting status. Fiscal
years end September 30. FY2015–2024 rounded to nearest ten; earlier source vintages use exact counts.
